description: This file contains styling for the word counter application, defining variables for colors, layout styles for various components including buttons, text areas, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: word-counter-app
classes.description: Main container for the word counter application.

classes.name: counter-card
classes.description: Styling for the counter card component, including background and box shadow.

classes.name: counter-header
classes.description: Styling for the header of the counter card.

classes.name: word-counter-textarea
classes.description: Styling for the text area where users input words.

classes.name: counter-btn
classes.description: Styling for the buttons used in the word counter application.

classes.name: counter-stats-row
classes.description: Styling for the row displaying word counting statistics.

classes.name: counter-pill
classes.description: Styling for the pill-shaped labels displaying statistics.

classes.name: visually-hidden
classes.description: Utility class for accessibility, hiding elements visually but keeping them accessible to screen readers.

classes.name: frequency-stats
classes.description: Styling for the section displaying the frequency statistics on larger screens.
